issues.issue: The General Fund's 8,685 inside this line is the Cemetery department (pp9, 12), and detail[33]-detail[36] categorise it as health/welfare. The statement line puts all of it in streets/highways. The extractor recorded the dominant category with a review note; it is defensible but inconsistent with the detail.

The Statement of Activities (p2) shows 56,000 of this as general government operating grants and contributions, with no source stated. It may be a government grant (intergovernmental) rather than a private donation. The same applies to detail[5]. This is a judgment call.

The printed line combines salaries with payroll taxes and benefits. 'salaries and wages' is the dominant object, but the line has no review note naming the mix. The same applies to the Library, Park and Pool lines with this label (detail[37], detail[43], detail[48]).
